provenance.standard: Econometric & Statistical Learning Standards (Belsley, Kuh & Welsch, 1980)
provenance.citation: Hastie, Tibshirani & Friedman (2009) The Elements of Statistical Learning (Penalized Regression, Springer)
provenance.pitfall: Collinear features (r > 0.85, VIF > 10) invert with high condition numbers, causing linear regression coefficients to oscillate with unstable signs and wildly inflated standard errors.
corner_cases: Tree models (Random Forest, XGBoost) do not crash with multicollinearity, but collinearity splits feature importances across correlated twins, distorting SHAP values.
Features derived from one another (e.g. Total Revenue and [Item Revenue + Tax]) forming exact linear dependencies.
One-hot dummy trap creating an exact linear combination with the intercept vector.

observes.description: Maximum pairwise absolute correlation among features
Maximum Variance Inflation Factor across numerical features
Linear/logistic models vs distance-based vs tree ensembles

alternatives.label: Pairwise Correlation Pruning
alternatives.description: For every feature pair with |r| > 0.85, retain the feature with higher mutual information to the target and drop the redundant partner.
alternatives.rationale: Severe pairwise collinearity observed in a linear model context. Pruning eliminates matrix ill-conditioning while preserving target predictive power.

alternatives.label: Iterative Variance Inflation Factor (VIF) Elimination
alternatives.description: Iteratively compute VIF scores and drop the highest-VIF feature until all remaining features satisfy VIF < 10.0.
alternatives.rationale: Multivariate linear dependencies detected across multiple features simultaneously (which pairwise correlation misses).

alternatives.label: L2 Ridge / ElasticNet Regularization
alternatives.description: Retain all collinear features and apply an L2 penalty to shrink correlated coefficients stably.
alternatives.rationale: L2 penalty adds an identity matrix to the covariance matrix (X'X + lambda*I), restoring strict invertibility and distributing weights smoothly across correlated features.

alternatives.label: Retain Collinear Features (Tree Ensembles)
alternatives.description: Allow tree models to split on collinear features without pre-filtering.
alternatives.rationale: Tree models do not perform matrix inversion; collinear features do not cause numerical instability.

verification.invariant: Linear model design matrices must have condition number kappa(X) < 1000 before solver estimation.
